info.title: Gulf Horizon Supplier Ratings
info.description: Fictional demo API returning supplier performance ratings for the Gulf Horizon Trading showcase.

get.description: Returns on-time delivery, quality score, open quality issues and approved-vendor status for all suppliers.
Returns the performance rating for one supplier. Supplier IDs: AN (Al Noor), DL (DesertLine), MCI (Meridian).

parameters.name: supplierId
parameters.description: Supplier ID: AN, DL or MCI

supplierId.description: Supplier ID: AN, DL or MCI

approvedVendor.description: True if the supplier is on the approved vendor list

onTimeDeliveryPct.description: Percentage of orders delivered on time in the last 12 months

ordersLast12Months.description: Number of orders placed in the last 12 months

source.description: Name of the supplier performance register

asOf.description: Date the ratings were last updated
